title: Tribal Masks
description: Wearable Tribal Masks for your enjoyment!
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9796cfe8f26e57b747fd8aab8d5335bae8364427.png)


Tribal Masks you can wear or display in item frame, perfect for messing with your friends or Roleplay projects. 

Put a Wooden Sword in an anvil and rename to your desired mask and you have a fun decoration.

If you'd like a mask that is wearable, just use this simple command to put the mask on your head! Afer that you can take it on and off just like a helmet. 

**For the Wearable "Evil Mask"**
```
/item replace entity @p armor.head with wooden_sword[custom_name="Evil Mask",equippable={slot:"head",equip_sound:"ambient.cave",equip_on_interact:true,swappable:true}] 1
```
**For the Wearable "Warrior Mask"**
```
/item replace entity @p armor.head with wooden_sword[custom_name="Warrior Mask",equippable={slot:"head",equip_sound:"ambient.cave",equip_on_interact:true,swappable:true}] 1
```
**For the Wearable "Fire Mask"**
```
/item replace entity @p armor.head with wooden_sword[custom_name="Fire Mask",equippable={slot:"head",equip_sound:"ambient.cave",equip_on_interact:true,swappable:true}] 1
```
**For the Wearable "Protectors Mask"**
```
/item replace entity @p armor.head with wooden_sword[custom_name="Protectors Mask",equippable={slot:"head",equip_sound:"ambient.cave",equip_on_interact:true,swappable:true}] 1
```
**For the Wearable "Lightning Mask"**
```
/item replace entity @p armor.head with wooden_sword[custom_name="Lightning Mask",equippable={slot:"head",equip_sound:"ambient.cave",equip_on_interact:true,swappable:true}] 1
```
**Installation**

Drop the resource pack into your resourcepacks folder and enable it.

**Version & compatibility**

Tested for Minecraft 1.21.x (pack_format 34).
